title: C6 task plan (schema c6-task-plan-v1)
description: The immutable, authorization-bound specification for ONE C6 task (v0.3.0). The operator authors this file; its canonical SHA-256 (TaskPlan.canonical_sha256) is bound into C6_AUTHORIZATION_RECEIPT.json task_bindings. The runner and CLI execute ONLY this plan; there are no free-form overrides. Runtime identity (finding F4): every docker plan pins an IMMUTABLE image_digest; the interpreter is resolved INSIDE that image and interpreter_version may pin it exactly; wheelhouse may be bound by wheelhouse_id. Oracle evidence (finding F3): the junitxml_path is injected into the frozen pytest command and the resulting junit-xml report inside the sandbox is the ONLY valid behavioral oracle.

command.description: Exact argv (test command frozen by the operator; the runner never invents commands).

test_paths.description: M/A test paths from the frozen F9 mapping (P-available ones).

t_only_paths.description: T-only oracle paths: bytes quarantined under oracle/ and executed ONLY in the separate oracle evaluator.

oracle_mode.description: Evaluation-role selector (v0.4.0). POSITIVE_REFERENCE (C6 default): verdict from the P2P positive reference (T code + T tests) while the F2P negative baseline (P code + T tests) is ALWAYS executed and recorded (expected_failure must never be treated as a broken environment). NEG_TESTS_EXPECTED_FAIL: verdict from the F2P baseline expectation. NONE: P code + P tests diagnostic only — never a PASS source (always BLOCKED).

isolation_backend.description: OS-level backend. docker is required for any network_bytes == 0 plan; python-process is harness-only (never for production).

image.description: Image reference for docker backend (era-canonical, operator-frozen; may be a tag). Runtime launch ALWAYS uses the immutable digest.

image_digest.description: IMMUTABLE OCI image digest frozen by the operator (sha256 hex). Required for every docker plan. The runner resolves plan.image locally and requires equality (ENV_DRIFT GLOBAL STOP on mismatch); mutable tags never serve as runtime identity.

interpreter_version.description: Optional exact interpreter version resolved INSIDE the pinned image (e.g. '3.9.14'). When declared, drift stops execution (ENV_DRIFT).

wheelhouse.description: Optional offline wheelhouse dir mounted read-only into the container.

wheelhouse_id.description: Optional frozen wheelhouse identity; when declared, mismatch stops execution (ENV_DRIFT).

junitxml_path.description: Container path (under /scratch-dir) where the runner injects --junitxml; the report becomes the machine-readable oracle evidence file.
